title: Quinten Tyvon - One More Time
htmlContent:
Quinten Tyvon gives his all to the listener on the new song “One More Time”. His presence is commanding with the right amount of vulnerability in his vocal approach, that makes you feel the intimate writing in a real way. This record thrives in the spirit of love songs with it making a connection with the listener, over this production that serves as the best stage for her to showcase his work.
